title: Temu's real trick was one parcel at a time
sentence: Until 2025, US shipments under $800 sent to one person entered duty-free under the de minimis rule; US customs says it handled 1.36 billion such parcels in fiscal 2024, before the exemption ended for China in May 2025 and for all countries in August 2025.
source: US Customs and Border Protection, interim rule (Federal Register, June 24, 2026): https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-12670
